# Resistance Labs

> Independent software studio building local-first knowledge systems and calm social platforms.

- Canonical URL: https://resistancelabs.tech/
- Founded: January 2026
- Headquarters: Amman, Jordan
- Structure: Bootstrapped Software Studio
- Founder & Lead Engineer: Abdallah Arabi (abdallah@resistancelabs.tech)
- Primary GitHub: https://github.com/Resistance-Labs-Tech
- Contact: founders@resistancelabs.tech

---

## Executive Summary

Resistance Labs is an independent software studio building commercial tools for knowledge workers, researchers, and intentional communities. We design applications centered on local-first data ownership, bounded operating sessions, and private intelligence.

---

## Active Product Portfolio

### 1. ATLAS:Face
- Category: Personal Knowledge System (PKS) & Spatial Reader
- Status: Production Release v1.0.32
- Platforms: Windows (.exe), macOS (.dmg), Linux (.AppImage, .deb)
- Live Portal: https://atlasface.resistancelabs.tech/
- Repository: https://github.com/Resistance-Labs-Tech/atlasface
- Commercial Model: Free local-first desktop core; optional Pro cloud synchronization and team workspaces ($12/month).
- Core Capabilities: 3D spatial knowledge graph, integrated active recall cards, local SQLite/Markdown storage, and multi-document semantic literature synthesis.

### 2. Suntown
- Category: Moderated Daily Social Room & Community Network
- Status: Live in Production
- Platform: Progressive Web Application (PWA)
- Live Portal: https://suntown.town/
- Public About Page: https://suntown.town/about/
- Operating Cadence: 4-hour daily Golden Hour ritual (14:00–18:00 UTC), closing completely outside the window.
- Commercial Model: Free community cohorts by application; sustaining memberships ($8/month) for custom town instances and community support.
- AI Integration: Uses Claude models to evaluate prospective member application responses against community standards and writing commitments prior to admission.

### 3. Developer & Focus Utilities
- RL-01 Latch: Desktop workspace defender for deep work commitment (https://github.com/Resistance-Labs-Tech/latch).
- RL-02 Reclaim: PWA inhibitory focus training with brown-noise masking (https://github.com/Resistance-Labs-Tech/reclaim).
- RL-03 Resistor Mark: Avatar generator for intentional digital focus (https://resistancelabs.tech/generator.html).

---

## Technical & AI Architecture

1. **Member Admissions Screening (Claude Models)**:
   In Suntown, prospective members submit written responses that are evaluated using Claude models to determine whether applicants understand community customs and meet the requirements to participate in the town.

2. **Semantic Knowledge Synthesis**:
   In ATLAS:Face, high-capacity contextual reasoning parses full-length books (EPUBs) and academic papers (PDFs) to build conceptual connections across personal research.

3. **Local-First & Data Privacy**:
   No third-party ad networks, no telemetry auctions, and no training on user personal notes. User data lives on local disk in standard SQLite and Markdown formats.
